idiom_name: enum tag + union payload per grammar rule, one eval() switching on the tag
implementation_notes: The usual C realization: one enum tag per grammar rule, a union holding each rule's payload, and a single recursive eval() that switches on the tag and recurses into the child AST pointers. Nothing in the language replaces the structure - -Wswitch only warns when a case is missing, it does not close the node set - so the grammar and the evaluator are both hand-written. Switch to the function-pointer form only when node kinds must come from modules that cannot be recompiled together.
pitfalls: A switch without -Wswitch and -Werror silently accepts a new tag whose case was never written, and C will happily let you read the wrong union member.
The tree is heap- or arena-owned: a recursive free or an arena reset must mirror eval's recursion, or every node leaks.
C has no exceptions, so evaluation errors (division by zero, unknown variable) need an out-parameter, a status field in the context, or a sentinel value - decide before the evaluator grows.

variants.name: Node structs with a hand-rolled function-pointer vtable
variants.idiom_name: struct node_ops { long (*eval)(const struct node *, struct ctx *); } embedded per node
variants.implementation_notes: The GoF structure written out in C: each node embeds a pointer to a static operations table whose eval slot is the abstract interpret operation, so dispatch is the same one-pointer-per-call scheme the class-based languages get from virtual methods, and a new node kind registers without touching the evaluator. It costs a pointer per node and one indirect call per evaluation, and it is the right form when nodes are contributed by separately built modules; otherwise the tagged union is smaller and faster.
pitfalls: The concrete struct must embed the base as its first member and every cast must match the actual node kind; C checks neither, so a wrong cast is undefined behaviour.
Nodes become heap-allocated and larger than union nodes, and the indirect call blocks inlining - measurable in a hot evaluation loop.
There is no exhaustiveness anywhere: an operation table with a missing slot is a null pointer dereference at evaluation time.
